cases.task: Choose the safe SSE ready-frame ID when a client reconnects with Last-Event-ID=5000 and no later matching event has yet been emitted.

required_facts.text: Browsers update Last-Event-ID when any SSE frame carries an id.
Sending id 0 on ready can reset the durable resume cursor before the next event or page frame.
The server has already validated and accepted cursor 5000.
